test_cases.name: happy_path_hierarchical_decomposition
test_cases.description: Full hierarchical decomposition across multiple depths with atomic leaf resolution and bottom-up merge.
test_cases.input: Execute recursive divide and conquer on monolithic task TASK-001 with 4 decoupled modules auth, billing, api, storage.

test_cases.name: atomic_base_case_immediate_resolution
test_cases.description: Immediate resolution when problem payload satisfies base-case threshold with zero decomposition.
test_cases.input: Execute divide and conquer on task TASK-002 where input payload is already atomic with 80 LOC and 1 endpoint.

test_cases.name: max_depth_exceeded_forced_conquer_or_halt
test_cases.description: Fail-fast or forced base case when recursive decomposition reaches depth ceiling 3.
test_cases.input: Execute divide and conquer on TASK-003 where subtasks continuously attempt decomposition beyond depth 3.

test_cases.name: partition_overlap_detected_defect
test_cases.description: Fail-fast when subproblem partitions share mutable scope or colliding identifiers.
test_cases.input: Execute divide and conquer on TASK-004 where partition-1 and partition-2 share mutable database state shared_credentials.

test_cases.name: base_case_execution_failure_defect
test_cases.description: Fail-fast when atomic leaf solver throws an unhandled error during CONQUER_LEAF.
test_cases.input: Execute divide and conquer on TASK-005 where leaf node solver throws unexpected runtime exception.

test_cases.name: merge_conflict_unresolved_defect
test_cases.description: Fail-fast when child branch outputs produce contradictory definitions or colliding keys during combine.
test_cases.input: Execute divide and conquer on TASK-006 where child branches emit colliding key mappings under STRUCTURAL_UNION.

test_cases.name: composite_validation_failed_defect
test_cases.description: Fail-fast when merged composite fails top-level requirement checks or dropped orphan subproblems.
test_cases.input: Execute divide and conquer on TASK-007 where merged composite artifact drops required module storage.
